title: Craft Blend 3-Mix Solo #12 (가로 띠·매끈)
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph with a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Chinese woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, clear fair skin, a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips, a dreamy, half-lidded expression, demure and soft, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, holographic finish.

Physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted with 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 30% of the way down her figure from the top and about 69% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer (deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms), wide gold-leaf bands following the contours of the body, dense eggshell-white scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework (a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework), wide gold-and-red bands following the contours of the body, dense geometric wax-resist linework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in French Limoges enamel (a deep cobalt-blue ground with fine white and gold grisaille scrollwork), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense grisaille scrollwork filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Footwear: extreme platform stiletto ankle boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Background & Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against her skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
